title: A fully faithful continuous cocontinuous bigger-site inclusion has a retraction
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] in a common universe [def-weil-size-convention], and let $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a functor. Assume (a) $u$ is cocontinuous [def-weil-pbc-special-cocontinuous-functor](1); (b) $u$ is continuous [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](3); (c) $u$ is fully faithful, meaning that every map $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(X,Y)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(uX,uY)$ is bijective; (d) fibre products exist in $\mathcal C$ and $u$ preserves them; and (e) $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ have final objects $e_{\mathcal C},e_{\mathcal D}$ and $u(e_{\mathcal C})\cong e_{\mathcal D}$. Write $R:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ for restriction, $(RG)(X)=G(uX)$, and $L:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ for the sheafified presheaf left adjoint $L(F)=(u_pF)^\#$ of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](3). Then $u$ defines a morphism of sites $f:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ with $f_*=R$, $f^{-1}=L$, and a geometric morphism $g:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ [def-trf-geometric-morphism] with $g^{-1}=R$. The adjunctions are $L\dashv R\dashv g_*$. The canonical unit $\eta:\operatorname{id}_{\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)}\to RL$ of $L\dashv R$ and the canonical counit $Rg_*\to\operatorname{id}_{\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)}$ of $R\dashv g_*$ are isomorphisms. In particular $f\circ g$ is isomorphic to the identity geometric morphism and $L=f^{-1}$ is fully faithful.
